info.title: CardiosensAI API
info.description:
API for the CardiosensAI connected health monitoring platform.

* **Patients, doctors and clinics** sign in with email and password and are identified by a 16-digit CardiosensAI ID.
* **Patients** upload readings from their devices, review history and ECG recordings, share selected data and create PDF reports.
* **Doctors and clinics** see a patient's data only after the patient approves a link, and only once CardiosensAI has verified them
  and they use two-step sign-in. Family members see only what a patient explicitly shared.
* **Administrators** manage accounts, device models and operations, and never receive health values.

Every reading keeps its device, acquisition mode (live, synced later, manual), quality and original UTC offset.
Uploads are idempotent: the reading's `id` is its idempotency key.

Not a diagnostic service. No clinical validation or medical-device certification is claimed.

post.summary: Start sign-up: sends a code to the mobile number (and email)
post.description:
Nothing is created until the codes are entered (POST /auth/register/verify).

The answer looks the same whether or not the number or address already has an account: an existing owner
gets a notice ("someone tried to register…") instead of a code, so the sign-up can't complete.

SMS down (MSG91 failing or not set up): with an email address the sign-up goes on with the email code only
(`phoneCodeSent: false`) and the account keeps the number unconfirmed until it is confirmed later; without one the
answer is 503 asking for an email address.

Sign-in step 1: a code to the email or number typed, and one to the account's other confirmed contact
post.description:
Email → code by email, mobile number → code by SMS (MSG91). If the account also has a confirmed number or email,
a second code goes there; either code signs in. Same answer whether or not the address has an account (then no
code is sent), and the answer never shows the other contact.
